free_tier.stated: No quota of its own: it converts a share link into a direct URL and borrows the sharer's link. The public instance is free and keyless and explicitly rate-limited

per_object_cap.stated: Not applicable, it stores nothing. What it resolves inherits the upstream per-file cap

retention.stated: Not applicable; signed redirects carry X-Amz-Expires=86400 and are cached for about 8 hours

egress.terms: Free. It issues a 302 to the real CDN origin, so the bytes never traverse the resolver and you download straight from the pan's own CDN

tooling: GET /parser?url=<encoded share>&pwd=<code> returns 302 to the CDN; self-hostable on ports 6400 for the API and 6401 for the web interface; JavaScript and Java parser plugins extend it
chaining: One endpoint, about twenty providers, no keys: the highest-leverage piece of glue found. Self-hosting it on a non-Chinese IP is what makes it durable, because the public instance's rate limits belong to its operator

limits.value: IP rate limits on the public instance
quark and UC need a cookie; feijipan and ilanzou need auth above 100 MB; 123 needs auth for large or login-gated shares

identity_cost.detail: the hosted instance is keyless. Self-hosting needs a VPS and no account with any pan

reliability_note: Individual parsers break whenever a provider changes its markup. The project is actively maintained, so pinning a version and watching the README changelog is the operational answer. The README warns that feijipan blocks mainland datacentre IPs and that the public instance should not be depended on

evidence.proved: 302 then 200, 9,314,348 B, application/octet-stream, and the ZIP passed unzip -t
302 to small5.bakstotre.com, and the CDN was unreachable from our egress, so a resolution is not a delivery
the supported list and auth table: '夸克网盘(QK) 必须：必须配置 Cookie 才能解析' '115网盘(失效)'; the professional tier adds 百度, 迅雷, 夸克, UC, 139, 联通 and 天翼

binding_note: The resolver is free and fast and stores nothing, so what binds is the auth table: the pans the client would most want, including Baidu, Quark and UC, need a cookie or sit behind the paid professional endpoint.
notes: Not storage and recorded as such: it is the fetch path for other people's storage. Two endpoints exist and the split is the finding: lz.qaiu.top is free and covers lanzou, ilanzou, ctfile, wenshushu, feijipan and ecpan, while 189.qaiu.top needs an API key and adds Baidu, Xunlei, Quark, UC, 139, 189 and Unicom.
